ObjectName.value: Document concerning the Prophet's hairs at the Al-Omari Mosque

Categories.value: Al-Omari Grand Mosque|PD-Ottoman|Template Unknown (author)|Scanned with Adobe Scan|Wikimedians of the Levant User Group uploads

ImageDescription.value:
A document concerning the transfer of custody of the key to the box in which the hairs of the Prophet Muhammad were kept at the Great Omari Mosque in Beirut. It reads:
"Previously, for the attainment of goodness and blessings in this city, the late Fuad Bey, the former Sadr, while serving as the administrator of these lands, undertook the task of obtaining the sacred relic from the Abode of Felicity, namely the blessed Prophetic hair, upon him be the finest prayers and the most complete and pure salutations. It was then placed in a small box inside the chamber situated within the venerable Omari Mosque.
At that time, it was recommended by the aforementioned authorities that the key to the aforesaid box should remain in the possession of the pride of the pious and righteous, His Eminence Shaykh Muhyi al-Din Efendi al-Fakhuri. The key was accordingly entrusted to the said Efendi, to whom this responsibility had been assigned, and has remained in his custody from that time until the present. He has thus enjoyed the honor and distinction of being the standard-bearer of this exalted and sacred service, while continually offering prayers for the welfare of the exalted Imperial Person, in recognition of the great honor and unparalleled favor conferred upon him.
Accordingly, a formal memorandum has been entered on this matter as a source of honor, so that Your Excellency may issue an order entrusting the key to a man who will perpetually enjoy this great distinction and remain diligent in offering prayers for the welfare of the Sublime Sultanate and Your Excellency’s illustrious person. In all respects, the command and decision rest with His Excellency, the holder of supreme authority.
16 Shaʿban 1289 AH."
